snippet.title: Buddy Advanced Guide: Mechanics | RingNet Scoop | Farlight 84
snippet.description:
Not sure how to use Sparky, Morphdrake, or Snatchpaw? In this episode of RingNet Scoop, we break down how to master each Buddy’s unique skills—from Smokey’s smokescreen tricks to Morphdrake’s perfect disguise and Snatchpaw’s smart steals. Quick tips, big impact. More Buddies coming soon—stay tuned!

#Farlight84 #RingNetScoop

ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
